lines: I had come to the school library, as usual.
It was a humongous library, spanning multiple floors beneath the school building, and housing research papers and writings on ninja arts from east to west, ancient to modern.
There were few people, so it was quiet, and the temperature control was perfect for the sake of protecting the books, so it was a much-cherished relaxation spot.
And once again today, I had gathered a variety of books from all over the place, just out of curiosity, and was absorbed in reading them all by myself.
What I had open right now was a recently-published paper entitled, 『A Study of the Igawa Clan Before and After the Kansei Reforms』, and it was pretty interesting.
However, after reading it so intently, my shoulders got stiff.
While cracking my neck as I rolled my head around, I idly searched for her.
The Book Girl of the Library.
A girl I wasn't even sure really existed, who would suddenly be there before I knew it, reading a book by herself.
She was never there when I tried to look for her.
And sure enough, she wasn't there this time either.
I was about to continue my book, when
The closing music began to play.
The student librarian here was awfully short-tempered, and would shut the doors immediately.
If that happened, then I would ultimately be locked inside, and unable to get out until opening time tomorrow.
I had to put back all the books I had taken, from shelves all over the place.
I hurriedly gathered the books in front of my eyes into my arms, and began scurrying around from bookshelf to bookshelf.
「This goes here, this goes here... This one's...... Mmm, where is it, where is it? Over there! Crap crap crap!」
Serene music resounded. There weren't even five minutes left until closing.
However, on top of being heavy and unwieldy, the books differed subtly in size from one to the next.
And for some reason, the library floor was smooth and slippery.
Being in a hurry, my feet slipped in spectacular fashion, and I accidentally threw the books I was holding at full strength―――But,
Paying no mind to me, with my hands on the floor, the books were gently hanging in the air.
On the other side of them was a girl.
The Book Girl of the Library―――or not.
It was a girl whose name I didn't know, whom I often spotted at the library, but had never talked to.
She gently waved her hands at the floating books, whereupon they began to fly through the air at incredible speed, and return to their original places on their own.
A Taimanin who controlled paper at will.
It was said they intertwined Taima particles and natural energies into the paper, to exert tremendous power in both offence and defence, but to think they could even do things like this...
In front of my astonished self, the books that I had gathered together had been put back on their shelves in the blink of an eye.
「Eh......? Uh, wait a moment. Um...... You saved me there. Thanks.」
「It was only because the books looked so pitiful.」
She muttered, and turned her back to me.
Though there hadn't been much emotion in them, those words were clearly blaming me.
Although she probably hadn't heard it, I apologized to the books that I had treated roughly, and escaped from the library just before I was locked in.
By the time I arrived home, the sun had set.
I had a feeling something like this had happened before. Sakura was waiting for me.
She thrust a letter at me.
A kiss mark on the envelope. And Chevalier's signature.
「You've been reading other people's mail without permission again......」
「I didn't read it! It got delivered, so I brought it to you. Sakura-chan went out of her way!」
I said thanks sarcastically, took the letter, and was about to break the seal, when I remembered.
The last letter I had received had had a sandman curse placed on it, which would put any person other than me to sleep if they read it.
Sakura had been tricked by the curse, hook, line and sinker, and it had been a major pain to remove it.
She must have remembered that too, because when I stopped my hand, she said,
「You're just going to read that behind my back anyway, aren't you, you cheater? Hmph!」
She turned her face away in a huff, and stomped into the house briskly with big steps.
Setting that aside, I opened it on my own.
This must have been about me having Chevalier search for a book written about my demonic power.
I expected it was also about a book from the sorcerer Barde Barde, which we had acquired together previously.
『To the rare human who aligns his ambitions with Chevalier's–—』
『One can tell a person by looking at their bookshelf. A phrase often spoken, don't you agree?』
『However, you will never understand a mage just by looking at their bookshelf. Especially not the mind of a wise one like Chevalier.』
There was the usual kind of opening passage, but when I read further, it was indeed a request regarding one of Barde Barde's books.
To sum it up, it appeared that Chevalier had found a grimoire that was difficult for her to handle alone, and she wanted me to help her investigate it.
According to her, it seemed that the grimoire used a special paper, and she wanted me to bring along a Taimanin who was proficient at dealing with paper.
She also said that, in case of an emergency, it would be helpful if we had a Fire Escape user who could incinerate the book.
「A Taimanin proficient at dealing with paper, huh?」
If that was the case, then I had just found one.
I didn't even know her name, and it looked like I had made her a little angry, but there was no doubt that she was a student of Gosha.
I would look for her tomorrow and try asking her.
As for the Fire Escape user, Kamimura Maika, with whom I had teamed up before, seemed like she would be reliable.
According to Chevalier, the most important thing in a woman's letter was the 『P.S.』 she wrote.
『By the way, might you be reading this letter together with some other girl again?』
『In that case, though she expects you know this already, without Chevalier, you and she cannot restore your bodies, now that they have become one.』
『Two faces, two sets of genitals, four limbs——Androgyny is the primordial form of love.』
『Chevalier is looking forward to seeing what kind of love you'll show her.』
『The one who intends to know everything between heaven and earth, Chevalier.』
It had been a cursed letter after all.
Furthermore, it seemed that my body would fuse with any woman I read it with.
「I'm technically her helper, though. This is why I hate witches......」
I tore the extremely dangerous letter to pieces and threw it away.
I wanted to meet the girl from yesterday, but I didn't know her name or class.
She probably wouldn't be in the library first thing in the morning. Should I wait until after school? No, hold on.
「Come to think of it, I've seen her with Mari before.」
Shinohara Mari, Earth Escape user, and class president, like Hebiko. I knew her class, of course.
And so, I decided to go and ask her.
When I called out to her from the classroom entrance, Mari looked up like she was surprised.
I beckoned her over to me.
「There's a Paper Spirit user you're often with. Do you know what class she's in?」
「Would that be Mai-chan? She's in the same class as me.」
「Yes, she is. Nanase Mai-chan. Mai-chan, Mai-chaaan!」
A girl who was reading a book raised her face.
「Why does she call me that? Mai-chan, Fuuma-san says he has something to talk to you about!」
The girl named Nanase Mai stood up, with a face that said this was a pain.
Unlike when she answered Mari's call, her face and voice were dreadfully cold.
「If that's all, then forget it. Bye.」
She was about to head back again.
「Ah, wait, wait. I'm getting to the point. Umm, I have a little something I want to investigate, and I'd like to get help from a Paper Spirit user.」
「No, not a mission. More like a personal errand of mine, I guess?」
She didn't go so far as to say 「I don't want to」 out loud, but her face was clearly telling me that.
「Uh, umm...... Well...... Fuuma-san, what do you want Mai-chan to investigate?」
「It's a sorcerer's book, but it appears that it uses a pretty special paper, and I'm told I'll need someone who's skilled at dealing with paper.」
Mai suddenly leaned forward with interest.
「Yes! What kind of book is it? What kind of special paper does it use? What's the author? What era? What's the manufacturing process?」
「I haven't seen the actual thing yet myself. It's with a witch in Tokyo Kingdom, so I was hoping you would go there with me.」
「Understood! By all means, please let me go with you. I'll follow you even if you tell me not to!」
Her eyes were twinkling. She was suddenly like a different person.
「A sorcerer's book. I wonder what kind of book it is♪ I'm looking forward to it♪」
Mai was making her heart swell with anticipation.
At any rate, it looked like she was going to accompany me, so that was a relief.
Next, I had gone to Kamimura Maika's classroom, but I couldn't see any sign of her.
Even when I asked her classmates, their answer was, 『She didn't come today.』
Prrrr♪ Prrrr♪ Prrrr♪ Prrrr♪ Prrrr♪ Prrrr♪ Prrrr♪ Prrrr♪ Prrrr♪
I was about to give up and end the call, when it finally connected.
I heard a terribly gravelly voice.
「Can'dcha tell, hearin' my voice? (Cough, cough!) Whaddya wand?」
「Sorry. I didn't know you'd caught a cold. I shouldn't have called.」
There was no way I could ask her for a favour like this. I was about to end the call, when
「Ih'z fine, dell me already. I'm strugglin 'guz I'm so dizzeh.」
「I needed a Fire Escape user, but it's my own personal business, and you have a cold, so never mind. Sorry, get well soon.」
「Agh, waid, don' hang ub, moron. Since you wen oudda your way to gall me, I'll azk Homura-no-anego...... (Cough, cough.)」
「Eh? I said it's all right. Sounds like your cold's rough. Just settle down and get some rest.」
By Homura-no-anego, she must have meant Sanada Homura, a graduate of this place and fellow Fire Escape user.
It seemed that Maika, who had a rebellious exterior but a strong sense of duty, was feeling sorry that she couldn't help because of her cold, and was talking to her senpai for me.
After waiting a little while, I got a call from her.
「Homura-no-anego sed she'd go wiv you. (Cough, cough, cough!)」
「I zaid, ih's vine. (Cough!) Ah'll gib you er condact invo, so tawk to Anego latuh. (Cough cough cough!)」
「I'm really sorry. Get well soon. Take care.」
Should I go check in on her sometime?
Despite the way she looked, she liked cute things, so she might enjoy a cute illness recovery charm or something.
At any rate, it wasn't what I planned, but I had been able to secure a Fire Escape user as well.
No offence to Maika, but she didn't have too good a reputation.
There was no doubt that she was the Taimanin's leading Fire Escape master.
But it came with the bonus of her being a “combat freak”.
At the very least, there were lots of rumours to the effect that she was extremely hotheaded, and didn't think about anything but fighting.
In fact, she occasionally came to school and challenged any strong-looking opponents to a mock battle, regardless of whether they were teacher or student.
Given her fighting style, which combined Fire Escape with a long spear, Maika didn't admire her as “Anego” (big sister/boss) for nothing.
For better or worse, I had never been challenged to a fight so far, but it wasn't like I had no connection to her at all.
Once, when I had been flung into an alternate world and turned into an auspicious beast on New Year's, I had been attacked by the Homura over there.
And when the Homura of this world was abducted by the Lady of the Spiders, I had been assigned to her rescue operation.
That said, we had been the diversionary force, so I hadn't met her face-to-face, though.
Mai and I had headed to Tokyo Kingdom, where Chevalier was waiting.
The arrangement was for us to rendezvous with Homura here.
We were only investigating a magic book, so Hebiko, Shikanosuke and Kirara-senpai weren't with us.
「Has Nanase-san ever been to Tokyo Kingdom?」
「Ahh, and I hear you turn paper into all sorts of shapes to attack, and your defence can even withstand Rinko-senpai's slashes or Yukikaze's lightning strikes, right? That's amazing.」
This conversation was kind of flat. Should I try changing the subject a little?
「What kind of books do you normally read?」
After tilting her head slightly, Mai said,
「Yesterday, there was First Love, Salammbô, Point Zero, Phoenix, The Character of Modern Students, The Knight of Olmedo, The Wei Wu Annotated Art of War, Anabasis―――」
Literature, history, mystery novels, manga, military strategy books, and titles that I didn't recognize when I heard them were brought up one by one.
I was someone who read a fair amount, but she seemed to read even more extensively.
What was more, these were all books she had read yesterday. That was a Paper Spirit user for you.
「―――The Epic of Gilgamesh, and Time Stranger. That's about it for yesterday.」
「Ah, and then Botchan, before I went to bed.」
「What kind of books does Fuuma-san read? You often read ninja art books, right?」
For the first time, she brought up a subject. Furthermore, she remembered what books I had been reading at the library.
「That's because I lead the Independent Commando Unit. I frequently reread texts on the fundamentals.」
「Like the three volumes of Bansenshuukai, Secret Methods of the Igawa Ninja, Secret Oral Teachings of the Koukawa, and so on?」
「Figures you'd know them right away, huh? Yeah, that's right. I discover new things when I reread them.」
「That's how favourite books are, right? I've read ones like VerTurt at least a hundred times.」
I didn't know that one. Since the conversation had finally sparked into life, I was about to ask her for details, when
「Yo, sorry I keptcha waitin'. You're Fuuma, huh?」
「Sorry for making you go out of your way today.」
「That's fine. I can't say no to a request from Maika. Hear she's got an awful cold.」
「'Sides, as I recall, you also pitched in when I messed up, right? I gotta repay that debt.」
「You want me to burn books, yeah? If it's just books, I'll burn as many as ya want!」
「No, I don't want you to burn books, I want you to dispose of a grimoire with fire in the event that something happens when we investigate it.」
「That so? Well, whatever. I'll go with you today.」
「By the way, who's that you got with you? That's a face I've never seen before. She a Taimanin?」
Though she didn't show it on her face, Mai seemed displeased by Homura, who talked about burning books as soon as she appeared. I could tell that much already.
「She's Nanase Mai-san, a Paper Spirit user.」
「Huuuh, paper? That stuff that burns up in a flash? Haha, this is great! Sounds like fun!」
「Umm, this person is our senpai and Fire Escape user——」
「All right, where're you taking me? I'll burn anything! You leave it to me!!」
「Also, honourifics and stuff are a pain. Casual speech, please, okay?」
Being slapped on the back by Homura, I started walking.
It looked like Homura didn't hear it, but her voice was sub-zero.
Homura and Mai. Flame and paper.
These two were the worst possible match, weren't they?
Today, since Hebiko wasn't here, that wolf man didn't show up,
And since Kirara-senpai wasn't here, no one fell for any shady cosmetics sales pitches, so we reached Chevalier's estate peacefully.
「It has been a long time, has it not?」
We were welcomed by Chevalier, and the guardian who had come to serve her due to that recent incident.
「This is most unexpected, for you not to have become one with anybody.」
Chevalier made a disappointed-looking face, seeing me safe and sound.
「Please don't put dangerous curses on letters asking people for favours.」
「It is not dangerous in the slightest. A man and a woman truly becoming one. That ought to make for a novel delight.」
「What would you do if we really did become one? Do that kind of stuff to yourself.」
「That would be impossible. Standing alone is proof that Chevalier is Chevalier.」
「The same as ever, huh? I brought the two people you wanted.」
「Paper Spirit user Nanase Mai, and Fire Escape user Sanada Homura.」
「I'm Sanada Homura. I can see at a glance you're a witch, right? Nice to meetcha!」
「May fortune smile on our newfound acquaintance. I will bring the book now. Do wait a moment.」
Chevalier left her seat, at which point the guardian began to speak to us.
「He's fine. Are you in contact with each other?」
「At times. I would like to try and travel to that Inageya place he was talking about previously, but I haven't the opportunity.」
A surprising friendship had formed, huh?
「Apologies for keeping you waiting. This is the book.」
What Chevalier had brought us was a thick, leather-bound, obviously magical tome.
「Then, I'll get right to examining it.」
Making her eyes light up, Mai tried to take the book.
「Do hold on. Were you to open it carelessly, you would be trapped by the book.」
「This book is 『Barde Barde's Catalogue of Books』. That is what is written on its cover in magical letters.」
「As that name would imply, it appears to compile a list of that library's books into one volume.」
「By 『appears to』, you mean you haven't looked yet?」
「A magical trap has been placed on it. From what Chevalier can tell, it is the kind which pulls one inside the book, you see.」
「Clairvoyance magic was not effective, either. We will have to open it up to read it. That much is obvious, though, isn't it?」
「So if we open it, we get caught in the magic trap?」
「Even for Chevalier, it may not be possible to egress.」
「Curiosity may be the font of knowledge, but the idea of “Get to know a horse by riding it, get to know a magick by casting it on yourself,” is not the act of a wise person.」
「In that case, why don't you try having this guardian open the book as a test? You know what kind of magical trap it is, right?」
「Oh, you beast! Oh faithless coward! Oh dishonest wretch! Die, perish!」
「Isn't that goin' too far? Sure, it's a mean idea, but...」
「It's a quotation from the comedy, 『Measure for Measure』.」
「That's as one would expect from a Paper Spirit user, hmm? And from Fuuma, producing that cruel idea on the spot. Naturally, Chevalier did try making her.」
「You did, huh? So that means it didn't work?」
「The magical trap does not activate for me. I am originally guardian of its library, after all. I was unable to even read the book.」
I could see where this was going.
And why Chevalier had summoned me.
「In other words, you want me to get caught in the magic trap on purpose. Is that it?」
Chevalier smiled like she was genuinely pleased.
「What wonderful perspicacity. Chevalier will be tracing you from the outside. That way, she will know the behaviour of the magic cast on you.」
「The inside of the book will almost certainly be dangerous, but if it's you, it will probably be all right.」
Since her servant was a no-go, she was going to throw me into the book. Chevalier was the same as ever.
「We're gonna fall into an enemy's trap on purpose, huh? Fun!」
Homura looked to be very enthusiastic, but Mai seemed apprehensive.
「Before that, could you try and examine the book briefly? Without opening it, of course.」
Mai took the grimoire with a tense expression, and began to brush its surface.
「The cover is goatskin. It's manufactured the same way as a Gutenburg bible―――」
「Ah, please wait. The front is made from a male goat, and the back from a female goat. Hmm, that's unusual.」
「Paired together on the front and back, hmm? Is the paper inside parchment? You need only tell by touching it.」
「That's...... true, isn't it? No, it's not. It's very well-made, but it's imitation parchment. Wow, amazing.」
Mai opened her eyes wide in surprise, and began a complex explanation about what its primary composition was, what the additives were, and so forth.
Leaving us behind, Mai and Chevalier had been talking for about five minutes, until
「Chevalier sees now. A specialist knows best. Leave mochi to the mochi maker, and paper to the paper maker, hmm? Such magnificent talent.」
「The pleasure is all mine. Thank you very much for letting me touch this rare book.」
「You will be sucked inside without a doubt. And, we will need to try and open it once. Could you do that?」
「I'm fine with it too! I mean, if I get trapped in the book, I'll just set fire to it from the inside.」
「What are you going to do, Nanase-san? This looks dangerous, so you can stay outside.」
「I'll go. That's why I came here, and besides...」
Regardless of whether a magical trap had been set, she seemed not to want to let Homura, who was gung-ho about torching the valuable book, go along.
「It's settled, then. Now, a gift from Chevalier.」
What Chevalier had held out were three brightly-coloured bookmarks.
「This is yuuzen washi paper, isn't it? Pretty.」
「They have spells put on them. With these, Chevalier can trace your positions.」
「If we are fortunate, Chevalier expects you will also be able to use these to communicate with her while she's outside.」
「Callin' through a bookmark is stylish, isn't it? I'll gladly take it!」
「Well then, please open the book, if you would. Chevalier and her servant will step outside.」
Chevalier and the guardian had withdrawn to another room.
「No prob. Let's go with a bang!」
The three of us nodded to each other, and, just in case, all opened the book together.
A pure-white light was emitted from the book. It was a sensation I had experienced a few times.
By the time I thought that,
I was in a gigantic library.
「Are you two all right?! Mai! Homura!」
「Y-Yes...... Just about...... Eh? Where is this?」
「I'm okay too. Oi, oi, what's goin' on?」
「More books inside the book, huh? It's chock full of 'em, isn't it? Feels suffocating.」
I also understood Homura's inclination to grumble.
It wasn't on a level that you could merely call spacious. It was books and bookcases as far as the eye could see.
「That book was a catalogue of books, right? Is that why it's a library?」
「It kinda looks like Gosha Academy's library, doesn't it?」
「It might be our image of a library, reflected back at us. That's the kind of thing magic traps have.」
I took out the bookmark I had received, held it to my ear like a telephone, and tried talking into it.
「Chevalier, can you hear me? It looks like all three of us have gotten inside the book. We're in an infinitely vast library.」
「Oooi, Chevalier! Can't you hear me? Answer, please.」
「Chevalier-san, Chevalier-san! It's no use. I can't get through either.」
「Hello! Hello! No use for me either. Not sayin' a word.」
「An effect of the magic trap, maybe? Chevalier did say we would be able to talk if we were lucky.」
「Guess that means we're unlucky, eh? Well, that's typical.」
Though the future suddenly looked uncertain, the three of us weren't going to be shaken by this little.
「There's nothing for it but to try and explore. A magic trap will have a key to undo its spell. Finding that's the quickest route.」
「All that said, this is a crazy amount o' books! What the hell's written in 'em?」
Homura tried taking a book off a shelf.
「Please wait. It feels like if you pull out a book, something bad will happen, doesn't it?」
「We can't get started unless we try. The key to undoing the spell's one of these books, isn't it?」
What Homura said was also correct. It looked like Mai understood that too.
「Shall we try looking at just one of them?」
I pulled a single book off a nearby shelf. I tried opening it, but nothing was written in it.
Mai reached her hand out to the book I was holding. She furrowed her brow slightly.
「It's no use. My Paper Spirit power won't penetrate it.」
「I've got a bad feeling about this.」
「That's a bullseye! They came along straight away!!」
A group of gargoyles were approaching us. And their numbers were great, too.
「Like moths to a yadda yadda yadda! I'll burn 'em all up! Ninja Art: Flame Whirlwind!!」
After swivelling her large spear overhead, Homura thrust it out at the group of gargoyles.
The huge flames that were supposed to surge out from her spearhead, however, were not produced in any shape or form.
「What?! You mean I can't make flames?!! What's goin' on?!!」
Homura hurriedly unleashed her spear once again, but not a single spark occurred.
「Is there fireproofing magic placed on the world inside the book?!」
The gargoyles launched themselves at Homura, who had botched her opening move, from all directions.
Mai fired a sheaf of papers from her bosom.

The bundle of papers, which looked to be rectangular paper strips for writing haikus, spread out in an instant, and furthermore, linked together to transform into a defensive barrier and block the gargoyles' attacks.
「Paper Spirit user Nanase Mai orders you. You there! Stop!」
If those things were made of paper, then a Paper Spirit user's orders should be absolute, but
The paper gargoyles were attacking us without any regard for that.
「As I feared, my Paper Spirit powers won't get through to them!」
「Looks like it, huh?!! My flames won't come out either!! Shit!!」
Homura swung her spear, which wouldn't emit any flame, and scythed down the gargoyles in apparent frustration.
Of course, I was also slashing the approaching enemies with my ninja katana.
Some paper that Mai had sent flying transformed into origami cranes in midair, and pierced through several gargoyles at once.
It looked like she could use her Paper Spirit Arts if it was on paper she had brought herself.
However, this was a library, and our surroundings were swarming with enemy paper. The gargoyles were advancing on us in droves.
「Even if you tell us to run, what're we meant to do about a swarm this huge?!」
「Nanase-san, it looks like you can use your own paper. Can you form a smokescreen or something?!」
「Yes, I can do that! Ninja Art: Wild Confetti Blizzard!」
An astounding amount of paper was scattered around.
The paper blizzard coloured everything in front of our eyes pure white.
We became unable to see the gargoyles, or anything else.
We had been able to take that opportunity to escape from our enemies, but before I realized it, I had gotten separated from those two.
Homura and Mai were hiding themselves in a secluded part of the library.
There was no sign of gargoyles around.
Mai had stretched strings of twisted paper into a pyramid shape, and formed a barrier that would evade the enemies' eyes.
「You saved me back there. Your paper's sure amazin'.」
Even though she was labelled a combat freak, it was for precisely that reason that she opened up to people she recognized for their strength.
Mai, on the other hand, didn't seem to be able to be that honest.
「Uhhh～～, so, uh. You read books and stuff a lot, I guess?」
Mai answered, but cut off there.
Unlike with Fuuma, she didn't tell her what books she had read, or bring up any subjects.
Naturally realizing that she was being avoided, Homura muttered to herself like she was at a loss.
「Well, you would read a ton, right? You're a Paper Spirit user, after all. I only read stuff like manga, though......」
「What kind, you say... Doesn't really matter, does it......?」
「So they're things like battle manga, I guess?」
「Don't stare like that! There's no choice. Don't laugh! Like, there's one called 『Versaillespring Turtle』.」
The tone of Mai's voice jumped.
It was a shoujo manga set in revolutionary France, about two hot spring girls competing in search of the legendary Versaillespring hot spring, which was fabled to cure everything.
「I haven't just read it. I love it! I've read it at least a hundred times!!」
「Hundred? Amazin'. I haven't read it a hundred times, but I've read it a few.」
「Really?! Really?! Homura-san, you read VerTurt?!! Uwaaaaaahhhh～～～～!!」
「What're you uwaaaaahh～～～in' about? Stuff like shoujo manga doesn't suit me, 's that it? I know that!」
「But I got hooked on it, so I can't help it, can I? That plot was hype!」
「I don't think that sort of thing doesn't suit you. VerTurt is a fiery story! It's electrifying!」
「Really! What side is Homura-san on? Aya? Mayumi?」
「Well, you gotta pick Mayumi. I like how she's called a genius girl, but she's not actually a genius.」
「I know, right?! I'm Team Mayumi too! Aya is too airheaded. And she's the protagonist! That's absolutely unacceptable!!」
「Y-Yeah. That's for sure. Didn't your whole personality just change? Well, whatever. Haha.」
Despite being surprised by the complete change in Mai, Homura's face softened, knowing that she liked the same manga as her.
The two of them got fired up about their shared interest, even forgetting that this was a world inside a book, and they were hiding from enemies.
「It was different in the standalone book than when it was printed in that magazine, right? I've only ever read the tankoubon.」
「I wanna read the magazine one, but I can't get a holda the back issues.」
「By going to the National Diet Library.」
「For real? The Diet Library's amazin'. But I've never been to the National Diet Library, and it sounds like there'd be a big hurdle to clear, goin' there to read manga, right?」
「Not at all. I can just go there and read them normally.」
「Well, that's 'cuz you're a Paper Spirit user...」
「I don't think that has anything to do with it, though. Well, shall we go together?」
「Sure. Ah, but please don't start any fires inside. The Library is non-smoking.」
「Idiot. It's not like I'm gonna, is it? I'm not an arsonist!!」
「You don't sound like you're jokin'! Seriously? I can read VerTurt, huh? Why didn't ya tell me earlier? Thanks!」
「Hey, please don't slap my back. I know you're pleased.」
The two of them had opened up to each other before they knew it.
But the next moment, the screeching cries of gargoyles rang out.
I slayed one of the gargoyles.
After all, the enemies were paper. They weren't hard to take down.
However, no matter how much I slashed and slashed, new gargoyles were born out of the bookshelves.
With a cold voice, a countless number of paper cranes flew out, and cut about twenty gargoyles to pieces.
「I'm sorry I'm late! I'll back you up!」
「I'm here too!! Take this, and this, and thiiiissss!!」
It wasn't just Mai who had come for me. Homura turned up while scything down enemies with her huge spear.
「No prob! Mai! Looks like this is gonna be a battle of attrition! Solidify our defence with paper!」
Mai swiftly waved her hands, whereupon the countless origami cranes instantly reverted to their original paper, and began to surround us.
「This is a paper shield that will protect you automatically. Please fight with peace of mind.」
「Don't underestimate me just 'cuz I can't use my flames! Here!!」
The three of us were taking down paper gargoyles one after another.
Although she couldn't control our enemies directly, Mai's power to command paper at will was still great.
We couldn't keep fighting forever, but might we be able to manage if it stayed like this? Just as soon as I wondered that,
The gargoyles gave off strange groans as they began, one by one, to stack on top of each other.
「What're those guys tryin' to do, gatherin' together?!」
「Please wait. Something is about to be born. That's...... a devil?!」
The assembled enemies' paper changed shape in an instant.
An enormous devil, with crooked horns, and sprouting wings from its back.
However, that guy was also made of paper. It was slightly dirty paper, like it had been smeared with sludge.
「Looks like the last boss has shown up, hasn't it?!」
「It must be. The power of all the paper in this world is concentrated in that.」
「That's a pretty straightforward key. If we beat that thing, we're bound to be released from the magic trap.」
「In that case, there's nothin' to do but take it down, right?!!」
The paper demon howled. The book world itself was rumbling.
